details: International companies using Brazil's Pix instant payment system are experiencing significant growth, with revenue increasing by up to 37% and customer reach expanding by an average of 25% within six months of integration. Pix has integrated 71.5 million Brazilians into the banking system, promoting financial inclusion and competition. Projections indicate that e-commerce transactions via Pix will reach $187.3 billion by the end of 2026, surpassing credit card usage in the country.
title: Brazil's Pix System Boosts Merchant Revenue and Financial Inclusion
